summary: V4-09 targeted invitation linkage is fully implemented and tested. The domain service (invitationService.ts) correctly handles targeted invitations by memberId, the join flow (join/[token].tsx) validates and links the exact named member, the UI (group-options.tsx, invite.tsx) exposes invitation creation for named members via native share sheet, and the repository layer records sync deltas for member updates. All 670 tests pass including the dedicated V4-09 test suite. Privacy, cost, i18n, typecheck, Expo exports, and Android prebuild all pass. No must-fix findings remain.
